title: Remove the Rust compiler warnings from TermAl's build and test build
outcome:
Greg, 2026-11-25 ~02:12Z, relayed by Engram::Asistant (TermAl mailbox 588693a8 #2677): „uwaga do termal'a, mozemy posprzatac warnings, sporo ich przy buildzie to nie powinno byc trudne”. These are simple changes, and they must not displace current priorities.

Baseline: the Windows full gate test-f43b85f6 on e6d8bd3c (parent ba577b3a), 2026-11-25.
- The normal binary has 7 warnings:
  - src/engram_build_checks.rs:84: field `0` is never read.
  - src/engram_build_checks.rs:133: fields `subject`, `observed_exit` and `rejection` are never read.
  - src/source_capture.rs:10: variant `UnsupportedGitlinks` is never constructed.
  - src/engram_observation_source.rs:6: variant `Legacy` is never constructed.
  - src/engram_root_authority.rs:308: field `fence` is never read.
  - src/test_run_causal_completion_batch.rs:17: method `causal_test_completion_plans` is never used.
  - src/test_run_causal_completion_batch.rs:223: method `read_causal_test_completion_batch` is never used.
- The test binary has 26 warnings. They are listed in that run's rust-tests.log.

Wanted: the current master builds with no warnings on Linux and Windows. Each warning is fixed at its cause:
- unused code is removed;
- code used only by tests becomes cfg(test);
- a value that should be read is read.
A warning is not hidden by a crate-wide or module-wide allow.
acceptance: On the candidate, the cargo-check stage and the rust-tests stage of `node scripts/test-launcher.mjs full --input commit` report no Rust compiler warnings, on Linux and on Windows. The warning counts, and the lists of their headers and paths, are recorded on the item from both full-gate runs, together with the baseline lists.

The cleanup adds no crate-level or module-level allow attribute. Every item-level allow introduced or deliberately retained to address a warning in this cleanup has a source comment explaining why the item is kept, and is listed on this work item. Pre-existing allowances unrelated to the warning baseline are outside this criterion.

Behaviour is unchanged. The full gate passes on the candidate on Linux and on Windows. The test names printed by `cargo test --bin termal -- --list` equal those of the candidate's parent, or each difference is recorded with its cause. No test is added that pins source text.
